instructions_to_main_agent: Implementation files must use standard React Javascript (.js) components.

Ensure every interactive button, input, navigation link, card, and metric container includes a kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='bento-card-capacity-matrix').
DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds under text. Always use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl and semi-opaque background fills (e.g., bg-[#12141F]/80).
All navigation links in the fixed header must link smoothly to page section IDs (#hero, #intelligence, #manage, #ledger, #outcomes, #cta).
Use Lucide icons for high-contrast technical indicators (AlertTriangle, Activity, Cpu, ShieldCheck, GitPullRequest, Layers, Sparkles, BarChart3).
Follow dark editorial theme rigorously with #0B0C10 base, #514EB3 indigo brand glow, #F59E0B delay amber, and #10B981 on-track green.
